title: [VR, Steam] Beat Saber $22.49 (25% Discount) Previously $42 @ Steam
body:
Deal: [VR, Steam] Beat Saber $22.49 (25% Discount) Previously $42 @ Steam

[DiscountForThee] A 100% must play for anyone who owns a VR headset
[blue130] It never needed a sale. But for anyone who didn't pick up the game for the reason of cost, they now can.
This game with mods is just amazing and it's replayability is massive.
[EspadaV8] Worth buying now even if you're on the waitlist for the Steam Frame?
[SkyeMG] Is it worth buying even tho I have it on the meta store
[SkyeMG] but playing it standalone on meta is less quality than pc streaming last i heard 🤔
[Martin31] True. But I always use stand-alone app more than PCVR. No hassle. Just pick and play
[SkyeMG] @Martin31: You got yours modded?
I fiddled with it years ago but tbh my quest doesn't get much use these days
[FujinShu] Afaik, beat saber is cross-buy between quest and rift (pcvr via meta store), so you can play the rift version on your pc with quest link or air link.
[yamumma] What about if you plan on selling the Quest and getting a Frame? Need to buy it again?
[Commodore64] I think there’s a big update just around the corner too
